title: Student Worker
bio: Debora Ortega-Maldonado (she/her) is a senior at Harvard College in Kirkland House double concentrating in Government and Women, Gender and Sexuality. Originally from New Brunswick, New Jersey, Debora is soaking and enjoying the time she has left in Cambridge. While at Harvard, Debora has worked in a wide range of positions from being a student worker for the Harvard Football team, to translating at the HLAB Law School Clinic and working for what was previously known as the Office of Diversity, Inclusion, and Belonging. Throughout her jobs, she manages to ensure representation, inclusion and belonging as her guiding principles. At the Foundation, Debora works to help facilitate the distribution of grants. When she’s not in the office, she likes to spend time with her roommates talking about anything and everything. Area Harvard Foundation
